findings.excerpt: title: "Uniform boundedness fails on the incomplete space c_00"
findings.symptom: The title renders the sequence-space notation c_00 as literal baseline underscores instead of mathematical subscripts.
findings.suggested_repair: Use title wording that renders the sequence-space notation, such as c₀₀ or “the finitely supported sequence space”.

findings.symptom: The title displays raw LaTeX delimiters, braces, underscores, and \operatorname instead of formatting the quotient seminorm and distance.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a plain text display title and leave the complete formula in the rendered Definition body.

findings.excerpt: title: c_0 is a closed subspace of ell-infinity
findings.symptom: The title renders c_0 with a literal underscore and does not identify ell-infinity in mathematical typography.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a display title such as “c₀ is a closed subspace of ℓ∞” or plain-text wording with no raw formula syntax.

diagram_review.candidate_assessment: No assigned item contains a TikZ or tikzcd diagram. The reviewed claims are supported by explicit formulas, coordinate descriptions, or proof text; no map or relation needs an extra schematic to disambiguate its domain, codomain, orientation, indices, or sign. Adding diagrams here would be decorative rather than clarifying.
mathematical_map_checks: thm-coordinate-map-for-a-finite-dimensional-normed-space: T: K^n -> X, (a_j) |-> sum a_j e_j; the formula agrees across the real and complex cases.

thm-fourier-differentiation-and-multiplication-identities-on-tempered-distributions: the stated Fourier convention gives the displayed derivative factor 2πiξ and multiplication factor -(1/(2πi))^|α| with the matching derivative sign.
lem-eigenspaces-of-a-self-adjoint-operator-are-orthogonal: uses the first-argument-linear inner-product convention consistently; distinct real eigenvalues yield orthogonality.
thm-unit-lattice-dirac-comb-is-fourier-invariant-in-tempered-distributions: test-function pairing and Poisson summation use the stated negative-exponent Fourier convention consistently.

thm-bounded-normal-operator-abstract-spectral-theorem and thm-borel-functional-calculus-for-bounded-normal-operators: the coordinate-function representation, spectral PVM, and Borel functional calculus domains and codomains are consistent in the displayed claims.

limitations: Review used only the repository frozen snapshots, assigned static HTML, and assigned screenshot tiles; no live HTTP or website inspection was performed.
All assigned visual tiles were opened separately at original resolution. The tile inventory is hash-bound below; no collage or downscaled crop was used.
No Scratch heading occurs in any of the 93 assigned frozen bodies.
